questions.q_en: In your light-plate assay the bacteria should respond differently to red and to green. What did you actually observe — do they stop producing under red and start under green?
questions.q_zh: 你們的光板實驗裡，細菌對紅光和綠光應該有不同反應。你們實際觀察到什麼？紅光下停止生產、綠光下開始生產嗎？
questions.a_en: Modulation rather than switching, and the two assays say different things. The ELISA is flat: about 3 micrograms per millilitre before illumination and 2.6 to 3.2 at every time point under both colours in the short-term set, and 12 to 13 in all four conditions of the long-term set. The DNPH activity does move — green above red at every short-term point, 8 against 6 at three hours, 12 against 9 at six and 18 against 16 at eight, and strongly at thirteen hours in the long-term set, 0.1249 against 0.0089 millimolar alpha-ketobutyrate, a fourteen-fold induction ratio. So no, they do not stop under red: green raises activity, red does not switch it off, and with n = 2 and overlapping error bars the honest sentence is supported at thirteen hours and unresolved at sixteen.
questions.a_zh: 是調節而不是開關，而兩個 assay 講的不是同一件事。ELISA 是平的：短期組照光前大約 3 微克每毫升，兩種顏色的每個時間點都是 2.6 到 3.2；長期組四個條件全部都是 12 到 13。DNPH 的活性確實會動——短期組每個時間點綠光都高於紅光，3 小時 8 對 6、6 小時 12 對 9、8 小時 18 對 16；長期組在 13 小時差距很大，0.1249 對 0.0089 毫莫耳 α-ketobutyrate，誘導比 14 倍。所以答案是「不會」：綠光會提高活性，紅光沒有把它關掉，而在 n = 2、誤差棒重疊的情況下，誠實的說法是 13 小時支持、16 小時未定。
questions.trap_en: Quoting our own Results key-result line, green light switches ACCD on. If a judge reads it out, correct it to green raises activity and red is not a clean off.
questions.trap_zh: 照著我們 Results 頁上的 key result「Green light switches ACCD on」講。如果評審念出來，要主動修正成「綠光提高活性，紅光不是乾淨的 off」。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: After thirteen hours we see a rise in production under the red light. How would you explain that rise?
questions.q_zh: 13 小時之後，紅光組的生產量反而上升。你們怎麼解釋這個上升？
kw_en: green falls more than red rises
kw_zh: 綠光掉得比紅光升得多
questions.a_en: The crossover is as much green falling as red rising: green went from 0.1249 to 0.0130 millimolar while red went from 0.0089 to 0.0923. For red not being a clean off state the explanation is hardware — CcaSR needs about 672 nanometres to switch off and our red LEDs emit at 640, and in the earlier wild-type blots the red reference was as strong as the brightest green, which looks like leakage from the green channel. For the fall under green we have two candidates we have not separated: the protein losing activity over extended incubation, and metabolic turnover of alpha-ketobutyrate, since DNPH measures an accumulated product and not a rate. Since the freeze we have built a 670 nanometre red plate specifically to get a clean off state, and that is the experiment that settles it.
questions.a_zh: 這個交叉與其說是紅光升上去，不如說是綠光掉下來：綠光從 0.1249 掉到 0.0130 毫莫耳，紅光從 0.0089 升到 0.0923。紅光不是乾淨的 off，解釋在硬體：CcaSR 需要大約 672 奈米才關得掉，我們的紅光 LED 是 640 奈米；而早期野生型的 blot 裡紅光參考組和最亮的綠光一樣強，那看起來像是綠光通道的光譜外洩。綠光掉下來這邊，我們有兩個還沒分開的候選解釋：蛋白在長時間培養後失去活性，以及 α-ketobutyrate 被代謝掉——因為 DNPH 量的是累積的產物，不是速率。凍結之後我們做了 670 奈米的紅光板，就是為了拿到乾淨的 off 狀態，那就是收掉這題的實驗。
questions.trap_en: Explaining only the red rise. Most of the gap at sixteen hours is the green group collapsing from 0.1249 to 0.0130, and that needs its own explanation.
questions.trap_zh: 只解釋紅光為什麼升。16 小時的差距大部分來自綠光組從 0.1249 崩到 0.0130，那需要自己的解釋。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: In your Western blot data the signal sits close to 100 kilodaltons, when ACC deaminase should be near 35 to 40. How do you explain that?
questions.q_zh: 你們 Western blot 的訊號落在接近 100 kDa，但 ACC 去胺酶應該在 35 到 40 附近。這個數據怎麼解釋？
kw_en: no loading control on the plate blots
kw_zh: 兩組 blot 互相矛盾
反應器那組 35 到 48 kDa
光板那組沒有 loading control
questions.a_en: Our two blot sets disagree, and the one with the predicted size is the reactor run: anti-His on cell lysate, lumen and shell medium between fourteen and forty-four hours gave bands between 35 and 48 kilodaltons, consistent with the roughly 41 kilodalton recombinant enzyme. The light-plate blots put the band just below or between the 75 and 100 kilodalton markers, and the same construct cannot have two masses, so something in those gels is wrong — the likeliest candidates are an incompletely denatured dimer, since ACC deaminase is only active as a multimer, or a marker and lane assignment error. We cannot choose between them from the images we have, because those blots carry no loading control and no plasmid-free WB800 lane. The fix is specified and cheap: re-run with a fresh ladder, a loading control and a WB800 lane, and quantify against it.
questions.a_zh: 我們兩組 blot 互相矛盾，而符合預測大小的是反應器那組：14 到 44 小時之間，anti-His 測細胞裂解液、lumen 和 shell 培養液，帶落在 35 到 48 kDa，跟大約 41 kDa 的重組酵素一致。光板那組的帶落在 75 到 100 kDa 標記之間或略低，而同一個構築不可能有兩個分子量，所以那幾片膠裡有東西錯了——最可能的是沒有完全變性的二聚體（ACC 去胺酶本來就只有多聚體有活性），或是標記與 lane 對應錯誤。從我們手上的影像沒辦法二選一，因為那組 blot 既沒有 loading control 也沒有無質體 WB800 lane。補救方法很明確也很便宜：換新的 ladder、加 loading control、加一條 WB800，重跑一次並據此定量。
questions.trap_en: Defending the high-molecular-weight band as if it were the right answer. The correct posture is that this blot set has a problem and the reactor set is the one we quote.
questions.trap_zh: 替那條高分子量的帶辯護，好像它就是對的。正確的姿態是「這組 blot 有問題，我們引用的是反應器那組」。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: Crucial: your ELISA shows no difference between green and red light, but your DNPH assay does. How do you explain that?
questions.q_zh: 關鍵問題：你們的 ELISA 在綠光和紅光之間看不出差別，但 DNPH 看得出來。這個現象怎麼解釋？
questions.a_en: They measure different things: competitive anti-His ELISA counts the protein whether or not it works, while DNPH only detects enzyme that actually turns ACC into alpha-ketobutyrate. The same gap appears in the reactor, where ELISA peaked at twelve hours and activity only at eighteen, with specific activity under 1 unit per milligram before rising to 6.3, so our reading is post-secretory maturation: ACC deaminase has to assemble as a multimer and load pyridoxal-5-phosphate, and neither happens the instant it crosses into the medium. Two things weaken the ELISA side specifically — the plasmid-free WB800 control gave 4.5 to 5.5 micrograms per millilitre on the same assay, and several wells sat above the top of the standard curve, so those are extrapolated comparisons and not certified concentrations. We have not tested the maturation explanation directly, and we also suspect light crosstalk between neighbouring light-plate wells flattened the ELISA further; both are named on the page as untested.
questions.a_zh: 它們量的是不同的東西：競爭型 anti-His ELISA 不管蛋白有沒有在工作都會算進去，而 DNPH 只偵測真正能把 ACC 轉成 α-ketobutyrate 的酵素。同樣的落差在反應器裡也出現：ELISA 在 12 小時達峰，活性要到 18 小時，比活性在 18 小時之前低於 1 U/mg，之後升到 6.3——所以我們的解讀是分泌後成熟：ACC 去胺酶必須組成多聚體並裝上 pyridoxal-5-phosphate，這兩件事都不會在它一跨進培養液的瞬間完成。有兩件事特別削弱 ELISA 這一側——無質體的 WB800 對照在同一個 assay 上讀到 4.5 到 5.5 微克每毫升，而且有幾個孔超出標準曲線上緣，所以那些是外推的比較、不是確定的濃度。成熟這個解釋我們沒有直接測過，我們也懷疑光板鄰孔之間的光外洩讓 ELISA 更平；這兩點頁面上都標示為未經驗證。
questions.trap_en: Going straight to the maturation story. This question tests whether you know your assay floor: admit the plasmid-free control signal and the out-of-range wells first.
questions.trap_zh: 直接跳到成熟那套解釋。這題考的是你知不知道自己 assay 的地板：先承認無質體對照有訊號、有幾個孔超出曲線範圍。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: You built two photometers, and one ran a twenty-day record. On the measurement page you tried different algorithms for the final OD value. What did you find after running all the algorithm tests?
questions.q_zh: 你們做了兩台光度計，其中一台跑了二十天的紀錄。量測頁上你們試了不同演算法來算最終 OD 值。全部跑完之後發現了什麼？
kw_en: the estimator is not the lever
questions.a_en: That the estimator is not the lever and the gate after it is. We replayed eleven algorithms on the same logged raw bursts, so the only difference is the algorithm, and in clean flow the largest gap between any two of eight was 0.0039 OD, less than a fifth of our own calibration scatter. Our sharpest pre-registered prediction failed: H6 said the upper estimator, which trusts the brighter half of each burst, would scatter at most half as much as the symmetric MAD; it scattered 0.77 against 0.78, because a bubble brightens the Pro at high OD and darkens the fibre-coupled Slim, so any one-sided estimator is betting on the geometry it happens to sit in. What fixed it was two acceptance gates — a spread gate catching 97 percent of bubble readings while rejecting none of the clean ones, and a jump gate that cut the worst bubble error from 2.44 OD to 0.016. Five of the eight predictions were not supported and we report all eight.
questions.a_zh: 結論是：估計量不是槓桿，估計量之後的那道 gate 才是。我們把十一種演算法在同一批已記錄的原始 burst 上重跑，所以唯一的差異就是演算法本身；在乾淨流動下，八種之間最大的差距是 0.0039 OD，不到我們自己校正散度的五分之一。我們最鋒利的預先登記預測失敗了：H6 說 upper（只信每個 burst 較亮的那一半）的散度最多只有對稱 MAD 的一半；結果是 0.77 對 0.78，因為氣泡在高 OD 下讓 Pro 變亮、卻讓光纖耦合的 Slim 變暗——所以任何單邊估計量都是在賭它剛好坐在哪一種幾何上。真正解決問題的是兩道接受 gate：spread gate 抓到 97% 的氣泡讀值而且沒有誤殺任何乾淨讀值，jump gate 把最糟的氣泡誤差從 2.44 OD 降到 0.016。八個預測有五個不被支持，而我們八個全部報出來。
questions.trap_en: Listing the algorithms. The result is a negative one about the premise behind the shipped estimator, plus the gate that replaced it; and the same study explained the 434-hour curve's false steps as quantisation.
questions.trap_zh: 把演算法一個一個列出來。真正的結果是「出貨版估計量背後的前提被推翻」加上取代它的那道 gate；同一個研究也解釋了 434 小時那條曲線的假階梯其實是量化假影。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: Your plasmid-free WB800 control reads 4.5 to 5.5 micrograms per millilitre on the same ELISA, and several samples sit above the top of the standard curve. What is your limit of quantification, and which conclusions survive it?
questions.q_zh: 你們無質體的 WB800 對照在同一個 ELISA 上讀到 4.5 到 5.5 微克每毫升，而且有幾個樣品超出標準曲線上緣。你們的定量極限是多少？哪些結論還站得住？
questions.a_en: The standard curve runs from 0.093 to 3 micrograms per millilitre in duplicate with an R-squared of 0.9967, so anything above 3 is extrapolation and we should call it that rather than a concentration. The plasmid-free WB800 control reading 4.5 to 5.5 means the assay also carries a host background in this matrix, so our numbers are apparent His-tagged protein and not recombinant-specific yield. What survives is the comparisons where both arms sit in the same matrix on the same plate — lumen against shell at 10.7 and 10.5, the shell permeate staying above the plasmid-free control through seventy-two hours, and the rank order of ACC deaminase against LEA14 and BoPep4 at roughly three to one. What does not survive is any absolute titre, and the fix is a dilution series that brings the samples inside the curve plus a matched medium blank.
questions.a_zh: 標準曲線是 0.093 到 3 微克每毫升、每點兩重複、R² 0.9967，所以超過 3 的都是外推，我們應該這樣稱呼它而不是叫它濃度。無質體 WB800 對照讀到 4.5 到 5.5，意思是這個 assay 在這個基質裡本來就帶宿主背景，所以我們的數字是「表觀 His-tag 蛋白」，不是重組蛋白專一的產量。還站得住的是兩邊在同一塊盤、同一個基質裡的比較——lumen 對 shell 的 10.7 對 10.5、shell 透過液 72 小時都高於無質體對照、以及 ACC 去胺酶大約是 LEA14 和 BoPep4 三倍的排序。站不住的是任何絕對效價；補救方法是把樣品稀釋到曲線範圍內，再加一個相同基質的空白對照。
questions.trap_en: Quoting 16 micrograms per millilitre as a titre. It is above the validated range of the curve, and the control on the same plate was not zero.
questions.trap_zh: 把 16 微克每毫升當效價報出來。它超出曲線的有效範圍，而且同一塊盤上的對照組不是零。

questions.q_en: In your PLP experiment the csn arm without PLP gives about 21 and the WB800 control gives about 32. The control is higher than the sample, yet your page says they are nearly identical. Which is it?
questions.q_zh: 你們 PLP 那個實驗裡，csn 不加 PLP 大約 21，而 WB800 對照大約 32。對照組比樣品還高，但你們頁面上寫「幾乎相同」。到底是哪一個？
pages: results#DNPH assay: ACCD activity and the PLP requirement
questions.a_en: The page overstates it and the right word is indistinguishable, not identical: the control sits above the csn arm, which at a single well per point and at the low end of the assay's range means the two cannot be separated, not that they are equal. What we can still claim is the comparison the experiment was built for — adding PLP raised csn by 13.7 nanomoles of product above the WB800 baseline and SamyQ with PLP by 30.0, so the cofactor requirement holds on both arms. What we cannot claim from this figure is that csn without PLP has no activity, because the host background in this matrix is at least as large. The honest sentence is that PLP is required for us to measure activity at all, and that this particular comparison needs replicates before it says anything about the arm without it.
questions.a_zh: 頁面講過頭了，正確的字是「不可分辨」而不是「相同」：對照組比 csn 那一組還高，而在每點只有一個孔、而且落在 assay 範圍低端的情況下，這意思是兩者分不開，不是兩者相等。還能主張的是這個實驗原本要做的比較——加了 PLP 之後 csn 比 WB800 基線高出 13.7 奈莫耳產物，SamyQ 加 PLP 高出 30.0，所以兩組都支持輔因子需求。不能從這張圖主張的是「csn 不加 PLP 就沒有活性」，因為這個基質裡的宿主背景至少一樣大。誠實的講法是：PLP 是我們量得到活性的前提，而這個特定比較在講不加 PLP 那一組之前，需要先有重複數。
questions.trap_en: Reading the sentence off the page. Naming the inconsistency yourself and saying which claim still stands is worth more than defending the wording.
questions.trap_zh: 照頁面上那句念。自己先點出不一致、再說哪一個主張仍然成立，比替用詞辯護有價值得多。

questions.q_en: ELISA peaks at twelve hours and activity at eighteen, and you call it post-secretory maturation. Give me one experiment that separates maturation from a protease clipping the His tag, and one that separates it from an assay artefact.
questions.q_zh: ELISA 在 12 小時達峰、活性在 18 小時，你們說那是分泌後成熟。請給我一個實驗分開「成熟」和「蛋白酶把 His-tag 切掉」，再給一個分開「成熟」和「assay 假影」。
pages: results#Bioreactor test: ELISA and DNPH over time
questions.a_en: For maturation against proteolysis, take the twelve-hour permeate, split it, and hold one half at assay temperature with PLP while the other goes straight to the freezer: if activity climbs in the held half with no new protein present, that is maturation, because nothing was being made. Proteolysis predicts the opposite signature and is read on a blot rather than an ELISA — a clipped His tag loses ELISA signal while the band shifts down a few kilodaltons, so the discriminator is size, not amount. For the assay artefact, run a spiked recovery: add a known amount of active enzyme into early permeate and into late permeate and see whether both return the same percentage, because matrix interference at six hours would show up as low recovery there and nowhere else. None of those three has been run, which is why the page says we have not tested this directly.
questions.a_zh: 要分開成熟和蛋白分解：取 12 小時的透過液，分成兩半，一半在 assay 溫度下加 PLP 放著、另一半直接冷凍；如果放著那一半活性自己爬上來、而且沒有新的蛋白被製造出來，那就是成熟，因為那段時間什麼都沒在做。蛋白分解預測的是相反的特徵，而且要用 blot 看而不是 ELISA——His-tag 被切掉會讓 ELISA 訊號下降、同時帶往下移幾個 kDa，所以判準是大小不是量。要排除 assay 假影就做加標回收：把已知量的活性酵素分別加進早期和晚期的透過液，看兩者回收率是否相同，因為 6 小時那個基質如果有干擾，就只會在那裡出現低回收。這三個實驗我們都還沒做，這也是頁面上寫「我們沒有直接測過」的原因。
questions.trap_en: Restating the mechanism in more detail. The question asks for discriminating experiments, so answer with the three designs and then say none has been run.
questions.trap_zh: 把機制講得更詳細一點。這題要的是能分辨的實驗設計，所以要回答三個設計，然後說我們都還沒做。

questions.q_en: 91.5 percent of your reference readings in the 434-hour run fell on an exact integer count, and 26 of the OD jumps came from the pipeline rather than the culture. Everything before October was read through that pipeline. Which published numbers change?
questions.q_zh: 434 小時那次實驗裡，91.5% 的參考通道讀值落在整數上，而 26 次 OD 跳動來自訊號處理而不是培養本身。十月之前的所有東西都是經過那條管線讀出來的。哪些已發表的數字會因此改變？
pages: measurement#What the instrument had already recorded
kw_zh: run 6 才是上了 gate 的紀錄
questions.a_en: The shape of the 434-hour curve survives and the small steps inside it do not. The outlier gate keeps samples within three median absolute deviations of the median, and when more than half of sixteen samples share one integer the deviation is zero, so the fence has no width and the filter collapses into taking the most common count: at 32 counts with a path-length factor of 5, one count is 0.067 OD. So the endurance claim, the fault-detection result and the 26.7 hours of lead all stand, because they rest on the reference channel stepping and on the run lasting, not on the OD value between steps; what cannot be read is any small OD change in that window, and the rejection percentage we had been calling bubbles was counting quantisation flicker in that regime. The TiO2 and SiO2 calibrations are unaffected, because they are paired readings against a benchtop instrument at each concentration. Run 6 is the first record taken with the gate fitted, which is why we point at it for growth numbers.
questions.a_zh: 434 小時那條曲線的形狀還能用，裡面那些小階梯不能。離群值 gate 保留中位數上下三個 MAD 內的樣本，而當十六個樣本有超過一半落在同一個整數上，MAD 就是零、圍籬寬度歸零，整個濾波器塌縮成「取最常見的那個整數」：在 32 counts、光程因子 5 的情況下，一個 count 就是 0.067 OD。所以耐久性的主張、故障偵測的結果、26.7 小時的提前量都站得住，因為它們靠的是參考通道在跳、以及這次實驗撐了多久，不是階梯之間的 OD 值；不能讀的是那段時間裡任何小幅度的 OD 變化，而我們原本當成「氣泡」在報的拒絕率，在那個狀態下算的是量化抖動。TiO₂ 和 SiO₂ 校正不受影響，因為那是每個濃度都和桌上型儀器配對讀值。run 6 是第一份裝了 gate 之後的紀錄，所以講生長數字時我們指的是它。
questions.trap_en: Saying the 434-hour run is invalid. It is the run that produced the fault-detection result; what is invalid is reading small OD steps inside it.
questions.trap_zh: 說 434 小時那次實驗作廢。那次實驗正是故障偵測結果的來源；作廢的是「讀它裡面的小幅 OD 階梯」。

questions.q_en: Your photometer's working limit is about OD 2.5 and the 5.57 scaling factor comes from one silica run. Your reactor runs report 2.71 and 3.77. What is the 3.77 worth?
questions.q_zh: 你們光度計的工作上限大約是 OD 2.5，而 5.57 的換算係數來自一次二氧化矽實驗。但反應器的紀錄報了 2.71 和 3.77。那個 3.77 值多少？
kw_en: above the limit it is extrapolation
sample beam a tenth of reference
silica calibrates the instrument, not the cell
kw_zh: 樣品光束剩參考的十分之一
二氧化矽校的是儀器不是細胞
questions.a_en: Above the working limit it is a turbidity extrapolation and not a density we would defend. Beyond about 2.7 the sample signal falls to a tenth of the reference, which trips the low-signal warning, and that is exactly what ended run 6 at thirty-seven hours: the beam died, the reported value stepped to about 9.9, and the gate marked the stretch rather than publishing it. The deeper limit applies to every number on that axis — silica calibrates the instrument, not the organism, because a one-micrometre bead is a sphere of refractive index 1.46 at 2.3 grams per cubic centimetre while a vegetative Bacillus subtilis cell is a rod, often in chains, nearer 1.33 to 1.41 and 1.1. So the ladder converts a reading into equivalent particle counts, and a dilution series of washed cells is still owed before any of it becomes cell mass.
questions.a_zh: 超過工作上限之後那是濁度的外推，不是我們會替它辯護的密度。大約 2.7 之上，樣品訊號會掉到參考的十分之一、觸發低訊號警示，而這正是 run 6 在 37 小時結束的原因：光束掛了、報出來的值跳到大約 9.9，而 gate 把那一段標記起來而不是發布它。更深一層的限制適用於那個軸上的每一個數字——二氧化矽校的是儀器不是生物，因為 1 微米的球是折射率 1.46、密度 2.3 克每立方公分的圓球，而營養期的 B. subtilis 是桿狀、常常成鏈，折射率約 1.33 到 1.41、密度 1.1。所以這條梯子把讀值換成「等效顆粒數」，而在它變成細胞質量之前，我們還欠一條洗過的細胞稀釋系列。
questions.trap_en: Quoting 3.77 as a cell density. Say it is a turbidity reading above the characterised range, and that the conversion to cell count has not been done.
questions.trap_zh: 把 3.77 當細胞密度報出來。要說那是超出已表徵範圍的濁度讀值，而且換算成細胞數這件事還沒做。

questions.q_en: Two things changed between run 5 and run 6 — the acceptance gate went on and the permeate draw was halved. How do you separate them?
questions.q_zh: run 5 和 run 6 之間變了兩件事——接受 gate 上線，同時透過液抽取率減半。你們怎麼把這兩件事分開？
pages: measurement#The next run was the test
kw_en: we cannot, and the page says so
the end of the run called correctly
questions.a_en: We cannot, and the page says so rather than claiming the clean record for the gate. A slower draw pulls in fewer bubbles, so the fact that no window in run 6 exceeded twenty percent bubbles cannot be credited to the gate alone. What belongs to the gate by itself is narrower and we state it that way: thirty-one of 1083 readings held back instead of published, and the end of the run called correctly when the sample beam fell to a tenth of the reference and the reported value stepped to about 9.9 with nothing abnormal inside the bursts. Separating them properly is one run at the same draw rate with the gate off, which is a day of reactor time and the experiment we would run next on this axis.
questions.a_zh: 分不開，而頁面上寫的是這句話，不是把乾淨的紀錄記在 gate 頭上。抽得慢本來就會帶進比較少的氣泡，所以 run 6 沒有任何一個視窗超過 20% 氣泡，不能全算是 gate 的功勞。單獨屬於 gate 的部分比較窄，我們也是這樣講：1083 筆裡有 31 筆被攔下來而沒有發布，以及當樣品光束掉到參考的十分之一、報值跳到大約 9.9、而 burst 內部看起來完全正常時，run 的結尾被正確判定。要真正分開，就是在同樣抽取率下把 gate 關掉再跑一次，那是一天的反應器時間，也是我們在這條線上接下來要做的實驗。
questions.trap_en: Crediting the clean bubble record to the gate. Two variables moved together; name the narrow claim that is the gate's alone.
questions.trap_zh: 把乾淨的氣泡紀錄算成 gate 的功勞。兩個變數一起動了；要講出單獨屬於 gate 的那個窄主張。

questions.q_en: Your jump gate accepts a new level once three readings agree. An air slug lasting longer than ninety seconds therefore gets accepted. What is the fix?
questions.q_zh: 你們的 jump gate 只要三筆讀值一致就接受新的水準。那麼超過 90 秒的氣柱還是會被接受。怎麼解決？
pages: measurement#What this calibration does not establish
kw_zh: 頁面自己寫了這個限制
發警報而不是默默修正
questions.a_en: That limit is stated on the page, and it is why the gate raises an alarm instead of silently correcting: a growing culture does not move 0.05 OD in thirty seconds, so any accepted step that large deserves a human look. Software cannot do better than that, because when the flow cell fills completely with air all fourteen samples in a burst agree perfectly and are all wrong together — on 10 October the Pro read 0.74 to 0.91 against a true 3.18 and nothing inside those bursts looks abnormal. So the real fix is in the plumbing: fix the inlet below the surface, keep it clear of the stirring vortex, and add a bubble trap, because a gate can reject a bad reading but cannot replace it. On the day it happened the cause was an inlet tube that had fallen out of the beaker, and one alarm would have had someone put it back inside the first minute.
questions.a_zh: 這個限制頁面上就寫了，也正是 gate 選擇發警報而不是默默修正的原因：一個在生長的培養不會在 30 秒內移動 0.05 OD，所以任何被接受的這麼大的階梯都值得人去看一眼。軟體做不到更好，因為當流通池完全充滿空氣時，一個 burst 裡的十四個樣本會完全一致、而且一起錯——10 月 10 日那次 Pro 讀 0.74 到 0.91，真值是 3.18，而那些 burst 裡面沒有任何異常。所以真正的解法在管路：把進水口固定在液面下、遠離攪拌漩渦，並加裝氣泡收集器，因為 gate 可以拒絕一筆壞讀值，但沒辦法生出一筆好的來替代。那天真正的原因是進水管掉出燒杯，而一個警報就能讓人在第一分鐘內把它放回去。
questions.trap_en: Proposing a cleverer filter. No estimator rescues a reading taken through air; the answer is an alarm plus hardware.
questions.trap_zh: 提出一個更聰明的濾波器。沒有任何估計量能救回一筆穿過空氣量到的讀值；答案是警報加硬體。
